runs.text: What does the kiosk gain by keeping orders with one shape per state, instead of four loose values?
With loose values, you have to check everywhere that the data makes sense. With a variant, what makes no sense cannot be written.
An order delivered with no time can no longer be written.

justification.text: The delivered shape requires the time: the error disappears before running.
It is not what matters: what matters is what can be written.
is needed, but the engine warns if a shape is missing.
